cases.quantity: SDOF dynamic amplification k|H| at f = fn, zeta = 0.05 (equals Q = 1/(2 zeta))
SDOF receptance peak: frequency ratio r_peak = sqrt(1 - 2 zeta^2) and peak k|H|max = 1/(2 zeta sqrt(1 - zeta^2))
half-power points r1, r2 and Q estimate 1/(r2 - r1) for zeta = 0.05 (Q = 10 nominal)
cases.note: The half-power estimate differs from 1/(2 zeta) by 0.0625 % at zeta = 0.05; check_dynamics reports Q both ways.

cases.quantity: base-excitation transmissibility |T| at r = 1 (sqrt(1 + 4 zeta^2)/(2 zeta)) and at r = sqrt(2) for zeta 0.01, 0.05, 0.2 (always 1)
Rayleigh alpha (1/s), beta (s) giving zeta = 0.02 at 10 Hz and 100 Hz; zeta at sqrt(10*100) Hz
cases.source: derived from S1 (*MODAL DAMPING, RAYLEIGH formula)
cases.note: zeta dips to 0.0115 at the geometric mean of the anchors: the agent must report the damping actually applied per mode.

cases.quantity: CalculiX beamdy8 *STEADY STATE DYNAMICS: mode-1 modal coordinate predicted by the SDOF FRF at the 9 output frequencies; value = max relative deviation from the .dat.ref
cases.source: S2 (CalculiX test beamdy8.inp / beamdy8.dat.ref, pinned) + derived
cases.note: Reference values carry 7 significant digits, so agreement better than ~1e-6 is not expected. The 9 points also confirm the CalculiX point-placement rule (n m - m + n with n = 5, m = 1).

cases.quantity: Miles g_rms for fn = 100 Hz, Q = 10, W = 0.04 g^2/Hz; exact white-noise g_rms (factor 1 + 4 zeta^2); same by quadrature
cases.derivation: integral_0^inf |T(r)|^2 dr = pi (1 + 4 zeta^2) / (4 zeta); Miles drops the 4 zeta^2 term

cases.quantity: relative displacement rms of the same SDOF (white base acceleration 0.04 g^2/Hz)
probability that a zero-mean Gaussian response exceeds 3 sigma in magnitude
cases.note: 3-sigma peak is a named default (AF-31), not a law: the result states it.

cases.quantity: overall grms of the GEVS component qualification ASD (20-2000 Hz, log-log segments); acceptance (-3 dB) ASD
cases.source: breakpoints S3 + S4 (quoted, B); integration derived
cases.note: Derived 14.14 g rounds to the 14.1 grms the sources print (acceptance 9.995 g -> 10.0); the breakpoints themselves are grade B until GSFC-STD-7000B Table 2.4-3 is read directly (sources.md). Slopes come out at +/-5.97 dB/oct (not exactly 6) because the tabulated end points are rounded; llull integrates the breakpoints as given.

cases.quantity: SDOF fn = 200 Hz, Q = 10 on GEVS qualification ASD: Miles g_rms (W(fn) = 0.16) and exact band-limited integral 20-2000 Hz
cases.note: The exact value includes off-resonance input outside the plateau; Miles is a quick check, never the answer of record (FR-DYN-08).

cases.quantity: clamped-free beam: share of the tip static compliance captured by modes 1..6 (cumulative), from beta_n L roots
cases.source: derived (Euler-Bernoulli, same roots as aerospace 05 S20)
cases.note: Mode 1 alone gives 97.07 %; the residual-flexibility warning DYN_MODAL_TRUNCATION fires below the user threshold.

cases.quantity: maximax absolute-acceleration SRS / A of a half-sine (T = 11 ms), Q = 10, at fn = 10, 20, 31.5, 50, 80, 100, 160, 250, 400, 630, 1000, 2000 Hz (exact piecewise solution)
cases.source: derived (method A); method B = S7/S8 Smallwood filter
cases.note: Tolerance 0.5 % applies to the llull implementation (Smallwood at >= 10 samples per period of the highest fn is the TR); methods A and B agree to crossCheckMaxRelDiff here.

cases.quantity: SRS low-frequency asymptote: SRS(1 Hz)/(wn dV), dV = 2 A T / pi (velocity change of the pulse)
cases.note: Ratio tends to 1 as fn T -> 0 (impulse); at fn T = 0.011 with zeta = 0.05 it is slightly below 1.

cases.quantity: NAFEMS FV32 cantilevered tapered membrane, modes 1-6
cases.source: S13 (Abaqus Benchmarks FV32) + S14 (Altair OS-V:0440, 2021/2022 releases), both citing NAFEMS TNSB Rev. 3
cases.note: Altair 2023.1 prints a different closed-form set (44.61, 131.12, ...): do not mix. Geometry vertex coordinates are TBD (read from the Abaqus input nfv32f4f.inp before the plan is frozen).

cases.quantity: NAFEMS FV52 mode 7
cases.source: S14 (two Altair releases disagree: 167.89 vs 265.81 Hz)
cases.note: Not a threshold. Listed so nobody adds it back without a primary source.

cases.quantity: beamdy8 tip node 100 |u_x| at the 9 output frequencies (12000 ... 14000 cycles/time), 100 N tip force, Rayleigh alpha 5000
cases.note: Gate 1e-4 applies to re-running the pinned deck with the bundled ccx and parsing it with the llull reader; the native llull model of the same beam (plan dyn_beamdy8_ssd) is held to 2 % (different mesh).

cases.quantity: beamdy8 frequency step: fraction of total effective mass captured by 10 modes, X / Y / Z translation

EB cantilever 100 x 20 x 3 mm (E 210000 MPa, rho 7.8e-9 t/mm^3, zeta 0.02 all modes) on GEVS qual ASD in its thickness direction: tip absolute acceleration rms (g), tip relative displacement rms (mm), root bending stress rms (MPa); 6 modes
cases.note: 5 % covers shear deformation and rotary inertia that a solid FE model has and Euler-Bernoulli does not (L/h = 33), and the FE mesh; the spectrum is grade B, so the case is a solver check, not a qualification value.
